name: Organization Strategic Fit Evidence Contract
purpose: Define the minimum governed evidence necessary to justify an Organization Strategic Fit assessment.
core_determination: Organization Strategic Fit measures the degree to which an organization's evidenced operating environment, priorities, needs, and adoption context align with capabilities the evaluating organization can presently and credibly provide.
unknown_rule: UNKNOWN SHALL NOT be interpreted as NOT_SUPPORTED and SHALL NOT automatically receive a numerical value of zero.
source_hierarchy: Procurement, planning, budget or capital-program records

dimensions.name: Problem Alignment
dimensions.required_determination: Does governed evidence establish a problem or need addressed by an existing capability?
dimensions.collection_objective: Establish whether the organization has a current evidenced problem or need addressed by an existing capability.
dimensions.completion_condition: The dimension has an explicit evidence state and every non-UNKNOWN determination traces to governed COF-EVD-* evidence.
dimensions.preferred_source_class: Official organization, government/regulatory, planning, procurement, budget, capital-program, authoritative industry, or credible secondary source

dimensions.name: Capability Alignment
dimensions.required_determination: Can an existing capability credibly address the evidenced problem without speculative product expansion?
dimensions.collection_objective: Establish which existing capability credibly maps to the evidenced organizational problem without speculative product expansion.
dimensions.completion_condition: An existing capability is identified and the alignment determination traces to governed COF-EVD-* evidence; hypothetical future capabilities do not satisfy this condition.
dimensions.preferred_source_class: Governed capability definition plus evidence supporting the organizational problem

dimensions.name: Operational / Infrastructure Relevance
dimensions.required_determination: Is that capability relevant to the organization's actual operating environment, infrastructure, assets, or workflows?
dimensions.collection_objective: Establish whether the capability applies to the organization's actual operating environment, infrastructure, assets, or workflows.
dimensions.completion_condition: The relevance determination traces to governed COF-EVD-* evidence describing the applicable operating environment, infrastructure, assets, or workflows.
dimensions.preferred_source_class: Official operational, infrastructure, asset, planning, regulatory, or authoritative industry source

dimensions.name: Strategic Priority Alignment
dimensions.required_determination: Is there evidence that the relevant problem is a current organizational priority, initiative, obligation, investment, or program?
dimensions.collection_objective: Establish whether the relevant problem appears in a current strategy, capital program, modernization initiative, regulatory obligation, procurement, investment, or equivalent priority.
dimensions.completion_condition: The priority determination traces to governed COF-EVD-* evidence showing current strategic, programmatic, regulatory, procurement, investment, or equivalent relevance.
dimensions.preferred_source_class: Official strategy, capital plan, modernization program, regulatory filing, procurement, budget, or equivalent authoritative source

dimensions.name: Adoption / Engagement Fit
dimensions.required_determination: Is there evidence of a plausible organizational path for evaluating, acquiring, piloting, or adopting the capability?
dimensions.collection_objective: Establish evidence bearing on a plausible organizational pathway for evaluation, pilot, procurement, acquisition, or adoption.
dimensions.completion_condition: The adoption or engagement determination traces to governed COF-EVD-* evidence; absence of evidence remains UNKNOWN rather than NOT_SUPPORTED.
dimensions.preferred_source_class: Official procurement, innovation, pilot, vendor-engagement, organizational, or credible authoritative source

approval_conditions: All five dimensions have been evaluated.
Every scored dimension is supported by governed evidence.
Every evidence reference resolves to a valid COF-EVD-* record.
Capability Alignment identifies an existing capability, not a hypothetical future product.
The evidence set meets minimum source-quality requirements.
The assessment records its evidence basis and integrity hash.
